GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast ! Restrained Took sit Settled Down 2nd Outside 1 Lengths with 1st following 4th 1x1, held together same to straightening up Joined in x 300m, dueled only Headed x 50m, Sound - # sat 2nd gave all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in at the start. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths turning, pocketed rounding turn , Lost Ground in Straight # never a factor
Jumped okay & Settled Down Mid Field 6.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 8 Lengths Two Wide turning, carried wider 250m, Made Ground in Straight # ran on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 250m was taken wider by the riderless horse.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length Two Wide , Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, emerged from pack in Straight as the only serious contender but only took a length off the winner in the run # battled on ok
Jumped Ok Settled Down 8th 7 Lengths off leader/winner within 5 Lengths x 600m, clear run home Outside kept trying without threatening - # kept on behind
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, inconvenienced 1200m and Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # back/ran on fairly
Jumped Ok Went Forward today Settled Down 2nd Outside 1/2 Lengths off leader/winner race run to suit same to turn ran into Lead x 300m, dueled with winner which came again, this # had its chance

Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside thus Settled Down Off Mid-Field Outside 8 Lengths with 1st following , 3 Wide @ 700m with a trail then went Five Wide Turning for home got wihtin 1 1/2 Lengths , # Sound Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over raced in the middle stages. Laid in under pressure in the home straight and passing the 100m, obliged to stop and straighten. Laid in over the final 50m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to Turn then Hooked Out to 4.5 Lengths out (=5-wide), steered two lanes past centre of track Straightening Up , ran on down the outside, hit Lead 140m and kept going to post # ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When placed under pressure, commenced to shift in near the 100m and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well landing on speed slotted in one x one fourth 4 Lengths (800m), peeled out 3 Wide Turn & travelled well, looming large 200 hit lead last 50m # enjoyed gun run

Jumped okay, allowed drift back & Settled Down 8 Lengths 3 Wide , Restrained and in Two Wide soon after, last trailing 9 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Ground in straight. [Stewards: Held up for clear running approaching winning post and went to the line unable to be fully tested.] # got too far back
Jumped ok Not Bustled at all settled down last couple fence 6 Lengths (1000m), off rail Soon After & coming up deepest into the Straight , held Ground only # back/wide/peaked
